DiskDigger can undelete and recover lost photos, images, videos, documents, or other types of non-media files from your internal memory or external memory card. Recovery Lost Photos & Videos helps you recover deleted photos, videos, audio files, documents, and lost text messages from your Android device. With full permissions, the app scans notification data from apps like WhatsApp. If you accidentally delete a message, it can be recovered within the app.

The app works in read-only mode to ensure no data is overwritten, and no personal information is uploaded or shared during recovery. It also supports recovery of multiple file types, making it a comprehensive tool for data recovery.
